title: Daniel Caesar at Wanderland
description: Daniel Caesar's soulful set at Wanderland Music & Arts Festival. Smooth R&B, golden stage lighting, and an electric crowd energy.

photos.caption: The band under a bank of white blinders, silhouettes and haze over the crowd.
Wide from the back of the field — the full stage rig lit cold and white.
Rainbow lens flare arcing across the whole frame above the stage.
Singing into thick blue haze, the band in silhouette behind.
Black and white: alone at the mic against a single hard light.
Guitar against the LED wall, the front row's phones lit up below.
Huddled at centre stage with the band, blinders burning behind them.
The full band in a line, smoke rolling off the front lip of the stage.
Turned away from the camera, one arm outstretched into the fog.
Arm extended with the mic, hand on chest, guitarist behind.
Backlit by a four-point star of blinders, the stage almost lost in white.
Lit from the side in white, the stage rig visible overhead.
The band small against a wall of projected faces.
Crouched at the drum riser, green footlights along the stage edge.
